## Publications & working papers

- **Police Abuse or Just Deserts? Deservingness Perceptions and State Violence** (with Mackenzie Israel-Trummel). *Public Opinion Quarterly* 86, no. S1 (June 2022): 499–522. [doi.org/10.1093/poq/nfac017](https://doi.org/10.1093/poq/nfac017){target="_blank"}
- **Bringing Abolition In: Addressing Carceral Logics in Social Science Research** (with Jordie Davies and Jenn Jackson). *Social Science Quarterly* (August 2021). [doi.org/10.1111/ssqu.13022](https://doi.org/10.1111/ssqu.13022){target="_blank"}
- **Lethal Force in Black and White: Assessing Racial Disparities in the Circumstances of Police Killings.** *The Journal of Politics* 81, no. 3 (July 2019): 1124–1132. [doi.org/10.1086/703541](https://doi.org/10.1086/703541){target="_blank"}
- **Mobilization Readiness and the Geography of Protest in the 2020 Uprising** (with Arica Schuett). Presented at the 2026 American Political Science Association Conference.
